verdict.rationale: Foreloop documents no built-in scheduler or recurring-job feature. Its CLI can be invoked 'from anything that can run one, including coding agents and cron,' but that recurring schedule comes from the user's external cron, a user-side workaround that earns no credit. PR reviews are triggered by pushes or @foreloop retest comments, which are one-off event triggers rather than recurring schedules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
